reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all241 original lines: M1–M8 dispatch, MC1–MC11, F2 lane synthesis, F3-A–F3-F, readiness gaps and later implementation-selected note. The original research-only/no-runtime stop is superseded by the October26 selection at the end; actual implementation status belongs to L1–L8 checkpoints, not this research label. Old PIDs/resume commands/model budgets/download permissions are historical, not live handles or authorization for a new wave. No report corpus, artifact, underlying source, external page, app or novel was newly inspected.

F2: A/P/M/U distinguish bounded native analogue/specific extension/missing named owner/insufficient evidence, not import percentages or source/gameplay completion. Preserve each lane's counts and overlapping rows rather than summing them. Xiaoxiang trial selector/admission/disabled alternatives differ from advertised ecology; ChangShengJue's comprehension/mastery/activity/physical money do not establish an immortal ladder/energy pool; Ascension release0.1.8.4 differs from main0.2 rewrite, and trial class is not a persisted playable trial. M4's four fan mods do not canonize empty handlers, pathway counts or stored honorific text. M5's inspected artifacts differ from two page-only plugins and unread executors.

F3: M6 catalogue29 includes a repeat and unopened hash-checked ImmortalStorage; M7 later acquired some initially limited candidates, but Chinese guzhenren/Gu Daoism gaps retain their own scope. Dawn and Shadowbound are separate fan mechanisms; no common-author identity or activated RI/Shadow Slave world follows from a quoted claim. Reddit22-thread/12-theme/10-mapping sample is purposive and mixed, not representative popularity or a taste mandate. The archive/rate-limit/seed-thread gaps remain. No copyright/acquisition route or external media retry is run by this review.

F4: Preserve F3's useful distinctions: current qi/foundation/progress, inherited versus retuned expression, individual item/companion/control identity, thermal history/recipient/held supply, real institution/service access and source-qualified power consumers. Existing native root/rate/bed-field/brood/living-gear observations are attributed bounded October26 inspections, not newly verified today or a generic capture/bond/Memory executor. Living Gu upkeep/control differs from activation essence; carrier injury/recovery/storage differs from evolution. Actual material/skill/power may work before identification under AD38. Canon source wins over fan mod values; a conserved-characteristic proposal is not an adopted universal conservation law.

F5: Acting guidance was already delivered by its separate owner, so M7-P4 is overlapping progress, not caused/installed by this wave. All later implementation selections preserve that separation and current PROJECT's chosen routes. Retain ranked candidate mechanisms and named source gaps; do not require every catalogue/Chinese artifact/effect body before a bounded selected consumer. Current ACR rules support useful repeated-work abstraction without compulsory chores/forced automation or a short-play target; strong actual means can remove costs. Original outcomes, proposals and provenance stay intact. No gameplay, worker/message, acquisition, migration, deletion, move, commit or push.

reviews.classification: full source-intake/implementation checkpoint review; qualified local mechanics and later authorization/delivery distinguished
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all163 original lines: both Rat-step routes, seam deviation, compatibility/origin schema, every test/browser/text-size row, known copy-loss edge and guarded commit boundary. Rat-step is the selected consumer, not Eda's resin lesson or page-level manuals. Current DOMAIN_RULES/SLR and learning owner B434 qualify the old general teaching-only-understanding shorthand: this local manual/guide stops at understanding, while a real embodied text, direct transfer or stronger means may confer more through its actual mechanism.

F2: The existing teacher and new native Book route converge on the same understood evidence and unchanged internalize/practice. Observation, held/read copy and paid/time terms are actual local prerequisites; correct-by-default manual is this authored copy's policy, not all text is truth. Eight reading units scale with native Literacy; the displayed eight-minute example is not a universal fixed reading time or Literacy-level gate. No additional study Literacy XP avoids duplicating this slice's reading reward, but does not ban independent legitimate rewards under SLR43. Understanding persists after losing the copy; the one-find exhausted route leaves the guide available rather than proving every world needs replacement books.

F3: Optional teacher/manual origin defaults missing legacy records to teacher and validates present origins at relevant understand/record seams; guide's frozen effects stayed unchanged. This is a concrete selected compatibility decision, not universal no-migration safety because a field is optional. Native Book progress and completed-read fact are the actual supplier, no mirror flag; read-but-unstudied reload has code reasoning only, separate from the played manual-origin persistence. Original Eda single-earned-choice invariant was deliberately not rewritten, so that alternative remains a named future join, not delivered by Rat-step.

F4: Focused12/12, first2554pass/1fail and later2561/0 belong to different dirty inputs/bundle identities, with the UI-contract failure attributed to another file and later clear. The teacher/manual fresh origins are actual recorded routes; persistence uses window.save_to_file/window.load_progress page functions, not OS file picker. Re-import resets practice2 to exported0 with manual origin, demonstrating that selected state. Text-size pass uses saved preset and measured heading21px, while descriptions/status retain smaller roles. Three sizes have DOM bounds but1920 screenshot tool crop means that row is not full visual proof. Post-study origin line was14px, not newly21px. Preserve these limits instead of claiming all copy scales or all keyboard/pointer flows were checked.

F5: Guarded commit owns named paths/hunks and leaves unrelated shared items/main/dist edits intact; committed source is not the current bundled/installed app, and not pushed is its historical publication state. Current PROJECT/AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51 govern selected follow-up. No source, browser/image, build/test, personal save, new book/acquisition, worker/message, migration, deletion, commit or push was performed in this review.

folds.heading: ## Manual route learning evidence reconciliation B572
folds.body: The full [K3 manual-route checkpoint review](gm/dispatch/refit-k3-2026-10-22/CHECKPOINT.md#content-reconciliation-b572-two-routes-and-text-size-proof) preserves a specific consumer: native Book reading plus self-study and a paid guide reach the same Rat-step understanding, while ownership/practice remains separate. Optional origin records and unchanged frozen guide effects have their own compatibility policy. Copy possession, finished reading, understanding and retained learning are not one flag; losing the book need not erase learned understanding. Its reward choice avoids duplicate Literacy XP in that slice without forbidding independent real rewards under SLR43. The resin-lesson single-choice invariant was left untouched, so that alternative is not delivered. Historical browser imports use page functions, read-but-unstudied restoration is code reasoning, and actual21px headings do not imply all smaller description/status roles or post-study text were verified at21px. This extends SLC37/SLC42/B434 provenance/proof distinctions, not a general rule that books or teachers cannot grant execution through a stronger means. No new learning/runtime/source proof is added.
